claims.sourceText: 24th NORAD Region Senior Director's log, 7 November 1975
claims.text: The 24th NORAD Region Senior Director's log for 7 November 1975 logs reports from missile sites M-1, L-3, LIMA and L-6 at 1035Z, the Harlow LCF at 1203Z, site K-1 at 1319Z and site L-1 at 1327Z, with surveillance unable to detect any track.
